author: Bruce Clifford
text: I’ve been putting it on my chest. Maybe 4 inches below my collarbone and about 3 inches from the center of my chest. Then switch sides with the next one. Been doing this for a couple years now. No more tearing it off on door jambs, getting in the washer, & dryer or getting in and out of my truck.
